title: 霞東フロア

style: Third-person open-world game cutscene look, live-action cinematic photorealism, shallow depth of field, steady game-camera motion, no anime, no illustration

world.name: Kasumi East floor
world.lock: Fictional open-plan office called Kasumi East: beige fabric cubicle partitions, light oak desks, grey carpet aisles, morning fluorescent tubes mixed with cool east window light, a few rubber plants, blank glass office doors, no readable letters on any surface

mio.lock: 27-year-old Japanese woman, adult face, shoulder-length black hair with a small matte clip on the right, cream blouse, navy pencil skirt, sheer black tights, low black block heels, a beige canvas tote on one shoulder, a navy lanyard with a blank white badge, tired calm morning expression, natural makeup

kuroki.lock: Japanese man in his late 40s, short black hair, thin metal glasses, charcoal suit jacket, white shirt, no necktie, black office shoes, looks at papers, unhurried

nana.lock: 29-year-old Japanese woman, adult face, short brown bob, pale blue blouse, grey slacks, sits at a desk with a mug, mild morning expression

props.tote: a beige canvas tote bag on one shoulder
props.badge: a navy lanyard with a blank white plastic badge
props.mug: a plain white ceramic mug on a desk

beats.place: Open-plan aisle at morning, a beige cubicle partition at the left, grey carpet running to a window wall
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left side at shoulder height, her body in profile to the aisle, holding still with a slight breathing bob
beats.action: Mio crouches in profile beside the cubicle partition, knees chest neck and face all aimed down the aisle, tote on her shoulder, while Kuroki walks slowly down the aisle away from her; nobody else is in frame
beats.sfx: HVAC hum, distant keyboard taps, one soft footstep on carpet
beats.music: Low pulsing synth bass with a single taiko hit at the start; holds under the whole clip

beats.place: A plain beige corridor wall beside an open glass office doorway, grey carpet, morning fluorescent light
beats.camera: Third-person camera at Mio's left side at shoulder height, her body in profile to the doorway, holding still with a slight breathing bob
beats.action: Mio stands in profile at the open doorway, knees chest neck and face all aimed into the inner office; Kuroki stays seated at the inner desk looking down at papers; both stay in these spots
beats.sfx: Quiet corridor, paper rustle from the inner room, HVAC
beats.music: Bass holds; a sparse tick on the downbeat

beats.place: The same open-plan office, a light oak desk row with beige partitions, morning window light, the whole shot stays this desk row
beats.camera: Static medium two-shot at eye level, a very slow push-in
beats.action: Mio stands beside the desk and speaks to Nana; Nana looks up from the mug and answers; both stay in the same spots

speech.line: いま ついた ばかり

beats.sfx: Quiet office, a mug set down, distant printer
beats.music: Soft warm pad, the bass rests

beats.place: A light oak desk in a beige cubicle, black mesh chair, morning window light behind the monitors
beats.camera: Over-the-shoulder third-person camera behind Mio at the chair, holding still
beats.action: Mio sits in the chair, rests her right hand on the mouse, and stays still; the tote sits on the carpet; the desk stays this cubicle
beats.sfx: Chair wheels on carpet, a mouse click, HVAC
beats.music: Bass returns with a slow taiko pattern
